div.div: تَرَاكِ an imperative verbal noun, meaning اُتْرُكْ [Leave thou, &c.]. (S, TA.) Hence the saying, تَرَاكِ تَرَاكِ صُحْبَةَ الأَتْرَاكِ [Leave thou, leave thou, the companionship of the Turks]. (TA.) Yoo says that تَرَاكَ is a dial. var. of the same; but this is only when it is used as a prefixed noun, as in تَرَاكَهَا for تَرَاكِهَا. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
